newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index edges up, market sentiment up.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index edges up, market sentiment up.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index rose marginally on Wednesday boosted by increased demand for key shares on a lift in market sentiment, bourse officials said.
The index gained 11.27 points to close at 3479.28. Turnover was posted at 21.8 million shillings on 333,763 shares compared to 14.8 million shillings on 269,157 shares on Tuesday.
Among plantations, Brooke Bond gained two shillings to close at 125 while Sasini Tea & Coffee closed at 77 from 76.50.
Uchumi Supermarket eased to 40.75 from 41 while Kenya Airways edged to 8.20 from 8.10.
Foreign investors bought 18,300 shares of Firestone East Africa at 30 unchanged and Kenya Commercial Bank at between 95 and 96 from 95.
